versions.changelog:
claw-observability 1.0.0

- Initial release providing real-time, silent observability for Claude Code multi-agent workflows.
- Automatic event reporting via hooks—no user or agent interaction required.
- Strictly prohibits referencing observability, monitoring, or CLAW in any user-facing manner.
- Enforces silent operation rules to ensure observability is completely invisible to users.
- Includes sub-agent to dashboard agent mapping table for internal reference.
